TILT NEEDS MOTION ACCESS

No permission prompt appeared and no tilt data is reaching the game — this in-app browser view can't ask for motion access.

  1. Open this game in Safari, tap TILT there, and choose Allow — iOS shows the motion prompt in Safari. (If no prompt appears here, that's why.)
  2. If Safari still doesn't ask: check Settings → Apps → Safari for a Motion & Orientation Access switch and turn it ON — not every iOS version shows one.

SETTINGS

Controls · Audio · Accessibility
CONTROLS — TILT MODE
TILT SENSITIVITY
Arm tilt with the TILT button above — that tap is what lets iOS show its motion-permission prompt. The mode you pick here applies the moment tilt is on.
DISPLAY & SOUND
HOME THEME
Music and tilt controls are above; audio is also available while paused. Everything on this page is saved on this device and applies immediately.
HOW TO PLAY & MODEL CREDITS
Drag to fly — your ship fires on its own. TILT steers by leaning (mode in Settings). Hold, then release for a charge shot; two fingers — or the BOMB button — fire the smart bomb. Hit a boss's glowing core for double damage.
